**What matters for FPL:**

- Atletico Madrid are in talks to sign Spurs captain Cristian Romero. _(rumoured)_ — [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c0qv4g0x79go?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13570615/cristian-romero-transfer-news-atletico-madrid-in-talks-to-sign-tottenham-captain-amid-inter-milan-interest), [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/aug/07/tottenham-and-atletico-in-talks-over-romero-with-van-de-ven-set-to-sign-new-deal)
- Micky van de Ven is close to agreeing a new Spurs contract. _(reported)_ — [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c5y3j1k8053o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/aug/07/tottenham-and-atletico-in-talks-over-romero-with-van-de-ven-set-to-sign-new-deal)
